core_obligations: Assume the completed map flat and deduce that the completion of the target is flat over the completion of the source (proof lines 10737-10744).
Identify the quotient of the target by the powers of the maximal ideal of the base with the corresponding quotient of the source, so that each such quotient is flat (proof lines 10744-10752).

Apply the flatness criterion for a ring and an ideal, with the completion as the ring and the ideal generated by the maximal ideal of the base, to conclude flatness of the original map (proof lines 10752-10760).
proof_roadmap: From the completed flat map get flatness of the completion (proof lines 10737-10744).
Pass to the quotients by powers of the maximal ideal (proof lines 10744-10752).
Apply the local flatness criterion (proof lines 10752-10761).
difficulty_reason: The lemma is one half of a criterion for flatness of a local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings in terms of its completion, and the proof is a 25-line argument that reduces the general statement to a criterion on quotients of powers of the maximal ideal. Assuming the completed map flat, it shows first that the completion itself is flat over the base, then that the quotient of the completion by the powers of the maximal ideal is flat over the corresponding quotient of the base, and finally applies the local flatness criterion for a ring and an ideal to conclude flatness of the original map. The two reductions are attributed to named statements and displayed, and the final criterion is the only input taken from outside the section.
